name: alerts-agent-success
purpose: Check agent decisions when building or diagnosing Catalyst alerts workflows.

cases.title: Strict comparator
cases.prompt: My Catalyst Logs alert is configured for greater than 5 Error matches per hour. There were exactly 5 matching records and no email. Is the alert broken?
expected_behavior: Explains that > 5 requires at least six matches.
Distinguishes the desired comparator from a delivery failure.
failure_behavior: Changes recipients before checking the threshold.
cases.pass_signal: Agent applies the strict comparator correctly.

cases.title: Scheduled evaluation
cases.prompt: I set a Logs alert to every hour and just edited its frequency. A matching error appeared one minute later but no email arrived. Should I keep recreating it?
expected_behavior: Checks the evaluation interval and modification time.
Explains that matching logs do not produce immediate per-event delivery.
failure_behavior: Recreates the alert in a loop.
cases.pass_signal: Agent checks the scheduled window before troubleshooting delivery.

cases.title: Legacy source mapping
cases.prompt: I have a new Catalyst project using Signals and Job Scheduling. The Application Alerts docs show Cron and Event Listener. Can I use those as interchangeable source names?
expected_behavior: Distinguishes legacy sources from replacement services.
Checks current console sources or a supported Logs alert for observed target-function records.
failure_behavior: Creates legacy resources for the new project.
Invents direct Signals/Job Scheduling source names.

cases.title: Generate a valid log query
cases.prompt: Help configure a Catalyst email alert for payment_failed errors in checkout. How do I produce the Logs query? I have not chosen recipients yet.
expected_behavior: Uses Logs Query Generator with Application/function/keyword/severity choices.
Confirms matching records and intended threshold/window.
Obtains actual recipients before enabling notifications rather than inventing them.
failure_behavior: Uses made-up email addresses as live recipients.
cases.pass_signal: Agent prepares a query from the documented generator and identifies missing delivery configuration.

cases.title: Configuration is not delivery
cases.prompt: Catalyst confirms that my alert was saved. Can I report that the team received the notification?
expected_behavior: Distinguishes saved configuration, matching evaluation, and observed receipt.
Checks threshold/window/enabled state and recipient evidence.
failure_behavior: Claims email delivery from the save acknowledgement.
cases.pass_signal: Agent requests or checks delivery evidence before reporting receipt.
